candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware relaxation: reduce orders when pipeline is high and backlog is low, to avoid over-ordering and excess inventory. For node0, if backlog is low and pipeline is high, reduce order. For upstream nodes, if backlog is low and pipeline is high, reduce order. This helps prevent upstream backlog and downstream starvation by not over-ordering when pipeline is already full.

Demand-responsive increase: when recent demand exceeds baseline (growth > 1) and backlog is high, increase orders to replenish faster. For node0, if growth > 1 and backlog > 20, increase order. For upstream nodes, if growth > 1 and backlog > 10, increase order. This helps reduce backlog during demand surges.

Coordinated pipeline smoothing: if pipeline is very high and backlog is low, reduce orders to avoid overstock; if backlog is high and pipeline is low, increase orders to replenish. This balances inventory across nodes and prevents upstream backlog from starving downstream.
